proposed_widenings.name: proxy_conjure family
proposed_widenings.justification: Conjure Fey conjures a persistent proxy entity, allows an optional melee spell attack on cast from the proxy's position, and then allows a Bonus Action on each subsequent turn to teleport the proxy and repeat the attack. No existing SpellMechanics family covers this: 'activation' executes all phases at cast time; 'ongoing_effect' is a passive modifier; neither models a persistent proxy + per-turn optional attack expenditure.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You conjure a Medium spirit...When the spirit appears, you can make one melee spell attack...As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can teleport the spirit...and make the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

proposed_widenings.name: apply_condition variant in Effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit effect applies Frightened directly (no save gate). The Effect type only has 'damage' and 'none'. There is no 'apply_condition' variant in Effect. The apply_condition atom exists in v4 and in MasteryEffect (via SaveGateRiderResult), but it is not exposed as a spell Effect variant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage...and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: frightened in Condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. Conjure Fey unconditionally applies Frightened on hit, requiring Frightened to be added to the closed Condition enum.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn

proposed_widenings.name: ability_modifier flat in DiceExpr
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage is '3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier'. DiceExpr.flat is typed as number (a static integer). The caster's spellcasting ability modifier is a runtime-resolved character-sheet value, not a fixed number. A new flat source like { kind: 'spellcasting_ability_modifier' } is needed, or a union type for the flat field.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes Psychic damage equal to 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier

notes: Primary gap is structural: no SpellMechanics family models the proxy-conjure pattern (persistent entity, optional attack on cast, repeatable Bonus Action attack on later turns). The v4 atom inventory has create_attack_proxy and attack_proxy atoms but no spell family wires them together. Secondary widenings (apply_condition in Effect, frightened in Condition, dynamic flat in DiceExpr) are needed regardless of which family is added. Slot scaling (3d12 + 1d12/slot above 6) fits linear_per_level axis=slot with no new types needed.
